description:
Animate Coveted Jewel using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
